stemMd: A positive integer leaves remainder 2 when divided by 5 and remainder 1 when divided by 3. What is the smallest such integer greater than 20?
explanationMd: Numbers above 20 that leave remainder 2 on division by 5 begin 22, 27, 32, 37. The first, 22, also satisfies 22 = 3 × 7 + 1. Because the list is increasing, finding the first match proves minimality.

distractorRationale.a: Twenty-one leaves remainder one when divided by five, not two.
distractorRationale.c: Twenty-seven leaves remainder zero when divided by three.
distractorRationale.d: Thirty-two leaves remainder two when divided by three.
distractorRationale.e: This satisfies the conditions but is not the smallest above twenty.
